newsitem.title: USA: Chic by H.I.S to sell part of German unit.
newsitem.headline: Chic by H.I.S to sell part of German unit.

text.p: Chic by H.I.S. Inc said on Monday it would sell part of its wholly owned German subsidiary, h.i.s-sportswear GmbH, in a public offering.

The sportswear company said in a statement it had retained a managing underwriter for a proposed initial public offering of a "significant minority interest" in the German unit, headquartered in Munich.
The sale is expected to occur in the second quarter of 1997. When completed, the German subsidiary's common stock will be listed on the Frankfurt and Munich stock exchanges.
The German subsidiary markets jeans and casual pants under the H.I.S. brand name primarily in Germany and, to a lesser extent, Austria, Switzerland, the Czech Republic, Poland and the Netherlands.
Further details were not immediately available.
